segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily T-zone and one with combination-to-oily skin report the product removes excess oil and leaves skin smooth without over-drying.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or normal/dry skin report the product cleans without tightness or dryness, though one found it too harsh and difficult to rinse off.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one who is also sensitive, report no issues and describe it as removing oil while purifying and smoothing skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, redness or breakouts even with daily use, while others report burning, eye irritation, or being told the product may be too harsh for their skin type.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report smoother texture and reduced fine lines, with one specifically noting it worked well on mature skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal/dry skin found the product too harsh and difficult to wash off despite it doing its job.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoothed fine lines and improvement in aging or mature skin with continued use; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry skin report the product does not strip or dry out skin and even feels moisturizing; one reviewer with normal/dry skin found it harsh and hard to rinse off.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report no redness or irritation with regular use, but this contrasts with several one-time users who report burning, swelling, or skin feeling like it was on fire.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product improved her skin barrier; no negative barrier-specific reports beyond general irritation complaints.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report cleared blackheads and visibly cleaner, tighter pores after a few uses; one notes it took two uses to see pores look cleaner.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report reduced breakouts, blemishes and acne clearing up within a week or two; one reviewer reports a temporary purge of pimples/breakouts around the jawline before improvement, and one reports actual burns rather than blemish improvement.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the product removes excess oil and controls oiliness, particularly in the T-zone.
